p1: [low, ominous] The night Ted Bundy escaped, the guards thought he was asleep in his bed... [whispers] It was a pile of books.
[low] And it wasn't his first escape.
[low] June, nineteen seventy-seven. Aspen, Colorado. He was allowed in the courthouse library... without shackles.
[low, tense] During a break, he jumped out a second-floor window.
[low] Six days later, police stopped a stolen car. [low, ominous] It was him.
[low] Back in jail, he lost weight... and cut a hole in his cell ceiling. [whispers] One foot wide.
[low] December thirtieth. He squeezed through... and crawled into a jailer's apartment.
[low] He changed clothes... [low, ominous] and walked out the front door.
[low] Nobody noticed... until the next afternoon.
[low] About two weeks later, in Florida... [low, ominous] he attacked a sorority house.
[low, ominous] The real number... [whispers] has never been confirmed.
